name: How does digital marketing differ for luxury properties versus standard homes?

mainEntity.name: How does digital marketing differ for luxury properties versus standard homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Digital marketing for luxury properties is highly targeted, focusing on platforms and demographics known for affluence. Unlike standard homes marketed broadly, luxury listings utilize exclusive international portals, high-end lifestyle websites, and sophisticated social media campaigns with precise audience segmentation. This strategic approach ensures the property reaches qualified buyers who are actively seeking premium real estate, a practical tradeoff for the increased marketing investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury digital marketing targets affluent demographics on exclusive platforms, unlike standard home marketing, which uses broader approaches.
